Act6-2#1.zh: 一早就没有看到林教头的影子；锦儿，你们老爷是有什么重要的事情吗？
Act6-2#1.t: I haven't seen Instructor Lin all morning. Jin'er, does your master have something important on?

Act6-2#2.zh: 今天一大早，高太尉府上的佣人送了一封信来；我家老爷看到这封信马上就出门了...
Act6-2#2.t: Early this morning a servant from Marshal Gao's manor brought a letter. As soon as the master read it, he went out...

Act6-2#3.zh: 高俅？信在哪里？快拿来看看！
Act6-2#3.t: Gao Qiu? Where's the letter? Quick, let me see it!

Act6-2#5.zh: 还在迟疑什么？这可是有关你们老爷的生命安全！
Act6-2#5.t: What are you waiting for? Your master's life may be at stake!

Act6-2#8.zh: 这不是鸿门宴吗？！林教头性命不保！
Act6-2#8.t: It's a trap of a banquet! Instructor Lin's life is in danger!

Act6-2#9.zh: 此话当真？！那我们还坐在这里干什么？快去救林冲啊！
Act6-2#9.t: Is that true?! Then what are we sitting here for? Let's go save Lin Chong!

Act6-2#12.zh: 锦儿，快搀扶夫人回房休息。同时吩咐全家大小开始收拾行李，叫马车准备；东京可能不能待下去了。我们马上去把林冲救出来！
Act6-2#12.t: Jin'er, help your mistress to her room. And tell the whole household to start packing and ready the carriage; we may not be able to stay in Kaifeng. We're going to get Lin Chong out right now!

Act6-2#13.zh: 鸿门宴被识破，众英雄合力闯虎穴！
Act6-2#13.t: The trap is exposed, and the heroes storm the tiger's den together!
